title_zh: 约定修正课堂水力发电模型的说明

scenario.label_zh: 约定修正课堂水力发电模型的说明
scenario.goal_zh: 明确水在模型中的作用与模型未接入电网的边界，并商定说明牌用语

context_zh: 科学课上的小型水轮模型由封闭水槽供水，只能点亮一颗模型灯；学员修订其展示说明。
author: author-phase11-a

sentences.speaker: Quinn
sentences.text: Our label says this model supplies power to the national grid. That cannot be right, can it?

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: No. It only lights this tiny lamp. There is no connection to the grid.

sentences.speaker: Quinn
sentences.text: And the water is the fluid that turns the wheel, rather than a fuel that gets burned?

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: Correct. A real dam may be immense, but this is only a small model of one part of the process.

sentences.speaker: Quinn
sentences.text: Then the label should say: flowing water turns the wheel to power the model lamp.

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: Yes. Remove the national-grid claim and keep that description.
